messages:
Asha Patel: Quick sync 10 final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private copy before launch. Focus: launch post cadence, webinar landing + signups, inbound lead routing, and microcopy to reduce pre-sales questions. Who takes which piece?
Miguel Torres: I can run launch posts and the social timeline. Hero should lean into predictable inference economics instead of model access.
Samira Chen: Dropped two hero candidates in the copy doc: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost" and "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference." Need punchier subheads and shorter leads.
Jules Park: Updated mocks to shorten CTAs: "Try Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Deploy Private". Also moved secondary CTA above fold to improve conversions.
Nina O'Connor: SEO note: prefer phrasing like "inference API" and "LLM inference platform". Avoid "LLM hosting". Use "deployment options" as H2 and add canonical link on /deployments.
Miguel Torres: Proposed schedule: wk1 blog + social blitz, wk2 benchmarks webinar, wk3 customer case follow-up. Webinar landing needs routing rules to Sales vs Growth SDR based on intent signals.
Samira Chen: Landing webhook pseudocode to include in the dev ticket:
```
// webinar signup routing pseudocode
if signup.email.endsWith("@company.com") && signup.estimated_monthly_tokens > 10000:
  route = "sales@redwood.com"
else:
  route = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"
// always attach utm_source and deployment_interest (hosted|dedicated|private)
```
Miguel Torres: Also: tag leads with deployment_interest derived from CTA click. If CTA == "Reserve Dedicated" mark enterprise-interest.
Jules Park: Microcopy for Dedicated card: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput. SLA-backed uptime and latency targets. Contact sales for capacity pricing." Tooltip: "Predictable performance at scale 1 ideal for production workloads."
Nina O'Connor: CRM lead schema to standardize: lead_type: webinar|trial|enterprise, deployment_interest: hosted|dedicated|private, lead_source: social|blog|webinar. Include all fields in webhook payload so mappings are clean.
Samira Chen: Post-signup email sequence: immediate thank-you (links: quickstart, runbook, calendar), day-before reminder, and follow-up with benchmark highlights + CTA for a dedicated trial. If routed to Sales, include SSO link and lead context.
Asha Patel: Final asks by EOD Thu: 1) finalize hero and 3 short CTAs, 2) add webhook pseudoconfig to the dev ticket, 3) draft webinar narrative (benchmarks + migration playbook + live Q&A). We want staging copy ready Fri when PR merges. :rocket: 
Miguel Torres: On it :thumbsup:
Samira Chen: Opening PR for copy + email templates and tagging reviewers.
deploy-bot: New deploy to staging scheduled for Fri 16:00 UTC 1 will include marketing pages if PR merged.
Asha Patel: Ping me if blocked, otherwise we'll ship the draft and iterate from analytics after the webinar.
